LCX is a platform based in Liechtenstein. LCX issues the LCX token, which is an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum blockchain.

Cheese Bank is a lending protocol on the Binance Smart Chain. Cheese Bank uses the CHEESE token. Cheese Bank was exploited in November 2021 through a flash loan attack.

PancakeBunny is a yield farming protocol on the BNB Chain. PancakeBunny distributes the BUNNY token to users. PancakeBunny was exploited in May 2021 through manipulation of the BUNNY token price.

Vesper Finance is a yield aggregator protocol on the Ethereum blockchain. Vesper Finance operates vaults that automate yield strategies for users. Vesper Finance uses the VSP token.

Uniswap & Linch refers to the decentralized exchange Uniswap and the DEX aggregator 1inch. Uniswap & Linch operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Uniswap & Linch allows users to swap crypto assets without a centralized intermediary.
